title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Florida International University
description: Ten under-21-safe food and drink stops around FIU’s Modesto A. Maidique Campus with late hours verified on current direct business pages.

cards.title: Sip305 After the Evening Stretch
cards.subtitle: Drinks, cookies and light food beside FIU
cards.notes: Walk to the SW 109th Avenue storefront for a late drink or snack; check the posted schedule before relying on the later weekend close.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus option serving drinks, cookies and light food through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Sip305’s official site lists its FIU location at 636 SW 109th Avenue and hours of 7:30 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 7:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: FIU location: Sunday–Thursday until midnight; Friday–Saturday until 1 a.m. Confirm same-day hours before departing.

cards.title: A Midnight Stop on Southwest Eighth
cards.subtitle: Halal Middle Eastern food near MMC
cards.notes: Head east along SW Eighth Street for a sit-down meal before midnight, leaving enough time for ordering rather than arriving at closing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby halal restaurant with the same midnight closing time every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Sahara Grill’s official page identifies 10526 SW 8th Street near FIU and lists daily hours of 11:30 a.m.–midnight.
cards.source_title: Sahara Grill – Middle Eastern Food Near FIU | Westchester, South Miami
cards.access_notes: Open daily until midnight according to the restaurant’s current official page; allow time for kitchen service before closing.

cards.title: Cookies Across from Campus
cards.subtitle: A dessert counter on SW Eighth Street
cards.notes: Use the SW Eighth Street shop for a late dessert pickup; verify the ordering page is accepting orders before making the short trip.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge cookie shop whose direct ordering page currently runs through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Night Owl Cookie Co.’s direct Toast ordering page lists the location at 10534 SW 8th Street and hours ending at midnight seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Night Owl Cookie Co. #100 Commissary | Toast
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists service until midnight daily; confirm that pickup is active before leaving campus.

cards.title: The All-Night Bakery Run
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour Cuban bakery on West Flagler Street
cards.notes: Use the Sweetwater branch when the night runs past other kitchens; confirm the specific branch because nearby Pinecrest locations vary.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock bakery west of campus with branch-specific hours published online.
cards.evidence_claim: Pinecrest Bakery’s official locations page lists its Sweetwater shop at 10780 W Flagler Street with 6 a.m.–6 a.m. hours every day, indicating continuous 24-hour operation.
cards.access_notes: The Sweetwater location is listed as 24 hours, with 6 a.m.–6 a.m. hours daily; verify the branch listing before travel.

cards.title: Tea Before Eleven
cards.subtitle: A late cafe on Coral Way near FIU
cards.notes: Settle in earlier if you want seating, then place the final order well before 11 p.m.; Sunday has a shorter published schedule.
cards.short_summary: A tea-and-boba cafe near FIU that remains open late on six nights of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: specialTEA’s official site lists 10766 SW 24th Street near FIU and hours through 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday, with an 8 p.m. Sunday close.
cards.source_title: specialTEA Lounge & Cafe | Miami's Original Tea Lounge
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 8 p.m. Sunday; use this as an earlier late-night stop and confirm same-day hours.

cards.title: The Weekend Croqueta Detour
cards.subtitle: A Friday-and-Saturday midnight kitchen
cards.notes: Save this Bird Road run for Friday or Saturday when the official schedule reaches midnight; other nights end at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Miami croqueta shop whose Bird Road branch extends service to midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Dos Croquetas’ official locations page lists its Bird Road shop at 10505 SW 40th Street, open until midnight Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday service runs until midnight; Sunday–Thursday closes at 10 p.m. Confirm kitchen availability before departure.

cards.title: Flagler Until Two
cards.subtitle: A late fast-food counter east of campus
cards.notes: Use the West Flagler location for a post-midnight run, and check whether the dining room or only drive-through service is operating.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Wendy’s with official hours extending past 2 a.m. throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists the 9655 West Flagler restaurant and drive-through until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 9655 West Flagler in Miami, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours extend to 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A 24-Hour Flagler Backup
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock lobby and drive-through service
cards.notes: Keep this Sweetwater location as an all-night option, but recheck the official page because overnight lobby access can change unexpectedly.
cards.short_summary: A West Flagler McDonald’s currently listing both its lobby and drive-through as continuously open.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page for 10530 W Flagler Street lists restaurant, lobby and drive-through hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Miami, FL at 10530 W Flagler St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists lobby and drive-through service 24 hours daily; confirm current overnight access before going.

cards.title: Tacos at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour SW Eighth Street location
cards.notes: Use the campus-edge location for the shortest all-night run on this board, and verify whether dine-in or drive-through access applies.
cards.short_summary: A close FIU-area Taco Bell whose official page currently lists continuous service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 10580 SW 8th Street lists the location as open 24 hours every day and identifies drive-through, late-night and delivery service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Miami, FL - 10580 SW 8th St
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open 24 hours daily. Check the current page to determine whether late access is dine-in or drive-through.

cards.title: The Later Kendall Sip
cards.subtitle: A second Sip305 counter with weekend hours to 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Choose the Kendall branch when its later weekend close matters; confirm the address so you do not stop at the earlier-closing FIU shop.
cards.short_summary: A farther Sip305 branch that extends the same drink-and-snack format later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Sip305’s official site lists its Kendall location at 9605 N Kendall Drive with hours to 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Kendall location: Sunday–Thursday until 1 a.m.; Friday–Saturday until 2 a.m. Verify the branch schedule before leaving.
